# TypesCastingCanBeUsed

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `TypesCastingCanBeUsedInspection`

Conversion helpers (`intval()`, `floatval()`, `strval()`, `boolval()`,
`settype()`), a string made of a single interpolated expression (`"$x"`), and
explicit `->__toString()` calls all perform a plain type conversion. A cast
expresses the same thing directly and avoids a function call.

## Example

Options: REPORT_INLINES = true, REPORT_TO_STRING_METHOD_CALLS = true.

::: code-group

```php{5,6,7,8,10,12,13,17,18,21} [Before]
<?php
namespace Store;

function normalize($qty, $ratio, $label, $item, $price) {
    $a = intval($qty);
    $b = floatval($ratio * 2);
    $c = \boolval($qty ?: $ratio);
    $d = intval($label, 10);
    $e = intval($label, 8);
    $f = strval($price);

    settype($qty, 'integer');
    settype($item['tags'], "array");
    settype($ratio, 'null');
    $ok = settype($ratio, 'int');

    $g = "$label";
    $h = "{$item->name}";
    $i = "#$label";
    $j = "{$label}{$qty}";
    $k = $price->__toString();
    return compact('a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f', 'g', 'h', 'i', 'j', 'k', 'ok');
}

class Tag extends Base {
    public function __toString()
    {
        return 'tag:' . parent::__toString();
    }
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
namespace Store;

function normalize($qty, $ratio, $label, $item, $price) {
    $a = (int)$qty;
    $b = (float)($ratio * 2);
    $c = (bool)($qty ?: $ratio);
    $d = (int)$label;
    $e = intval($label, 8);
    $f = (string)$price;

    $qty = (int)$qty;
    $item['tags'] = (array)$item['tags'];
    settype($ratio, 'null');
    $ok = settype($ratio, 'int');

    $g = (string)$label;
    $h = (string)($item->name);
    $i = "#$label";
    $j = "{$label}{$qty}";
    $k = (string)$price;
    return compact('a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f', 'g', 'h', 'i', 'j', 'k', 'ok');
}

class Tag extends Base {
    public function __toString()
    {
        return 'tag:' . parent::__toString();
    }
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 5: Use &#39;(int)$qty&#39; instead (a cast is clearer and faster).</li>
<li>line 6: Use &#39;(float)($ratio * 2)&#39; instead (a cast is clearer and faster).</li>
<li>line 7: Use &#39;(bool)($qty ?: $ratio)&#39; instead (a cast is clearer and faster).</li>
<li>line 8: Use &#39;(int)$label&#39; instead (a cast is clearer and faster).</li>
<li>line 10: Use &#39;(string)$price&#39; instead (a cast is clearer and faster).</li>
<li>line 12: Use &#39;$qty = (int)$qty&#39; instead (a cast is clearer and faster).</li>
<li>line 13: Use &#39;$item[&#39;tags&#39;] = (array)$item[&#39;tags&#39;]&#39; instead (a cast is clearer and faster).</li>
<li>line 17: Use &#39;(string)$label&#39; to make the string conversion explicit.</li>
<li>line 18: Use &#39;(string)($item-&gt;name)&#39; to make the string conversion explicit.</li>
<li>line 21: Use &#39;(string)$price&#39; instead of calling __toString() directly.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| REPORT_INLINES | bool | true | Enables the single-interpolation string check (D8–D9). |
| REPORT_TO_STRING_METHOD_CALLS | bool | false | Enables the `__toString()` call check (D10–D11). |

The upstream fixture enables both.

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "TypesCastingCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "REPORT_INLINES": true,
        "REPORT_TO_STRING_METHOD_CALLS": false
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore TypesCastingCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection TypesCastingCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
